rule_1_velocity.description: Four or more payment attempts by the same source account within a rolling 5-minute window

rule_2_shared_device.description: Three or more distinct sending accounts associated with the same synthetic device token within a rolling 24-hour window

rule_3_large_amount.description: Transaction amount significantly exceeding account historical baseline (>= 3x median and >= Rs. 50,000) or fallback threshold (>= Rs. 1,00,000) for new accounts

rule_4_cross_bank_movement.description: Rapid multi-hop cross-bank transfer chain retaining >= 80% of funds across distinct accounts and banks within 10 minutes
